items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: Didn't he have a brother, too, Earl?

ctx.x: That's right. Her and her husband. She played piano and he played drums, and Floyd and them was young. I think they had one sister that danced... And they had a pretty good act on the Orpheum Circuit at one time.
Didn't he have a brother, too, Earl? Or was that his sister's husband maybe...?
